$description: light mode roles for "originalCodecademy". Do not edit.

surface-sunken.$description: Wells, insets, code blocks — anything recessed into the page.

surface-default.$description: The page background — the base every other surface elevates from.

surface-raised.$description: Cards, panels, dialogs, menus. Higher elevation is lighter.

surface-success.$description: The success tint behind an alert or inline confirmation.

surface-warning.$description: The warning tint behind an alert or inline caution.

surface-error.$description: The error tint behind an alert or inline validation message.

surface-brand.$description: The two-color brand gradient. The color is the flat fallback; the gradient ships as --gradient-surface-brand.

gradient.cssVars: radial-gradient(circle calc(0.85 * 100cqw) at 100% -5%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-accent-300) 45%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-accent-300) 43%, transparent) 16%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-accent-300) 24%, transparent) 36%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-accent-300) 11%, transparent) 56%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-accent-300) 4%, transparent) 76%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-accent-300) 0%, transparent) 100%), radial-gradient(circle calc(1.21 * 100cqw) at 5% 100%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-primary-300) 45%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-primary-300) 43%, transparent) 16%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-primary-300) 24%, transparent) 36%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-primary-300) 11%, transparent) 56%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-primary-300) 4%, transparent) 76%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-primary-300) 0%, transparent) 100%)

surface-brand-subtle.$description: The one-color brand gradient, for backgrounds behind real text. Ships as --gradient-surface-brand-subtle.

gradient.cssVars: radial-gradient(circle calc(0.78 * 100cqw) at 50% -10%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-primary-300) 45%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-primary-300) 43%, transparent) 16%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-primary-300) 24%, transparent) 36%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-primary-300) 11%, transparent) 56%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-primary-300) 4%, transparent) 76%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--colors-palette-primary-300) 0%, transparent) 100%)

text-subtle.$description: Secondary text — descriptions, metadata, helper copy.

text-inverse.$description: Labels on a filled control — action-primary, -neutral, -danger.

text-warning.$description: Warning text and icons. Always with an icon.

border-strong.$description: Emphasis — an active field, a selected row.

border-default.$description: Any border that carries meaning — control outlines, field borders.

border-subtle.$description: Decorative hairlines — table rules, dividers. Contrast-exempt.

action-primary.$description: Primary interactive fills, strokes, links and focus rings.

action-neutral.$description: The neutral action fill. Button variant="secondary" resolves here.

action-disabled.$description: The disabled fill for every action variant. Contrast-exempt (inactive control).

state-hover.$description: Rest → hover on rows, tabs, chips, menu items.

state-pressed.$description: Hover → pressed on the same elements.

state-selected.$description: The persistent "this one is chosen" tint.

backdrop.$description: The scrim behind modals and dialogs. Mode-independent.
